---
title: Habitat type
format: html
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 10
#| out-width: "100%"
#| fig-align: center
library(leaflet)

# Read in your site metadata
sites <- read.csv("~/Documents/ATI_website/Data/sites_metadata.csv")
circles = data.frame(lng = sites$Longitude, lat = sites$Latitude)

leaflet() %>%
  addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldImagery") %>%  # Satellite imagery
  setView(lng = -149.84, lat = -17.5392, zoom = 11) %>%
  addCircles(data = circles, color = "red")

```
